key.name: asr-backend
key.description: Which transcription binary preset to use (whisper-cli, transcribe-cli, nero-asr, custom).

key.name: cli-mode
key.description: How to resolve the transcription binary. 'auto' uses the CPU-only transcribe-cli bundled with the extension (x86_64), falling back to a transcribe-cli found on PATH. 'manual' uses the absolute path set in cli-path (e.g. a Vulkan/CUDA build).

key.name: cli-path
key.description: Absolute path to the transcription CLI binary.

key.name: model-params
key.description: Extra arguments passed to the binary (model path, language, ...). Quote paths with spaces.

key.name: realtime-mode
key.description: Append --stream-chunk-ms 500 when supported by the backend.

key.name: custom-arg-template
key.description: Template used when backend is 'custom'. Placeholders: {cli} {params} {audio}.

key.name: active-model-id
key.description: Id of the active catalog model. When empty, the free-form model-params string is used instead.

key.name: model-dir
key.description: Directory where downloaded models are stored. Empty means ~/.cache/planeasr/models.

key.name: quant-preference
key.description: Quantization selected by default when a model offers several files (Q4_K_M, Q5_K_M, Q6_K, Q8_0, F16, F32).

key.name: accelerator
key.description: Compute backend: auto (let the CLI pick), cpu, or vulkan.

key.name: gpu-device
key.description: Index of the GPU device to use. -1 means auto-detect.

key.name: auto-detect-gpu
key.description: Probe for a Vulkan GPU at runtime and use it when 'accelerator' is 'auto'.

key.name: selected-language
key.description: ISO 639-1 language code or 'auto' for detection.

key.name: translate-to-english
key.description: Translate the transcription to English when the model supports it.

key.name: cpu-threads
key.description: Number of CPU threads to use. 0 means auto (all available cores).

key.name: vad-enabled
key.description: Enable Silero VAD to filter silence. whisper-cli only.

key.name: initial-prompt
key.description: Custom vocabulary or context biasing passed as the model initial prompt.

key.name: chunk-enabled
key.description: Transcribe long recordings live in N-second chunks while recording, streaming each piece as it is ready, so backends with a per-call generation cap (e.g. Qwen3-ASR) don't truncate the output.

key.name: chunk-seconds
key.description: Length in seconds of each chunk when 'chunk-enabled' is true. Lower values are safer for models that cap output tokens per call.

key.name: chunk-overlap-seconds
key.description: Seconds of audio re-transcribed at the boundary between consecutive chunks so words split across the seam are not lost. The overlapping text is removed with fuzzy matching. 0 disables overlap.

key.name: output-mode
key.description: Where to send the transcribed text: 'clipboard' or 'paste'.

key.name: last-text
key.description: The text produced by the last successful transcription.

key.name: last-audio-path
key.description: Absolute path of the last recorded WAV file.

key.name: toggle-record-shortcut
key.description: Global keybinding that starts/stops recording.

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: Log the ASR command line and its captured stdout/stderr to the system journal for troubleshooting.
